theses.author: Quant Research
theses.title: Post-FOMC Cash Position — SAMPLE UI ONLY
theses.thesis: Fed hiked 25bp; Warsh sounded hawkish; stocks soft, volatility still calm. After a widely expected rate hike and a hawkish press conference, the easy move already happened in the afternoon selloff. No liquid long-premium idea clears our edge bar today, so the book stays cash.
support_statements: Cheap short-dated puts look tempting but behave like lottery tickets when volatility is still low
No defined-risk setup meets our edge threshold after the afternoon selloff priced in the hawkish tone
Preserving capital for higher-conviction opportunities is the correct risk management posture
Re-open only if volatility clearly rebuilds or a named catalyst shows a defined-risk ticket under $200 with a clean kill line

levels.invalidation: Re-open if vol rebuilds or clean <$200 setup emerges
